welcome.title: notes
welcome.subtitle: Your folder. Your Markdown files. Nothing else.
editor.pickANote: Open a note from the sidebar, or create one.
readonly.not_utf8: This file is not valid UTF-8. It is open read-only; nothing will be converted without your say-so.
readonly.mixed_eol: This file mixes line endings. It is open read-only, because saving would silently rewrite them.
readonly.workspace: This workspace's state was written by a newer version of notes, so nothing here will be overwritten.
conflict.title: {name} changed on disk
conflict.body: Autosave is suspended for this note. Your text is safe in a draft; nothing on disk was overwritten.
draft.found: An unsaved draft of {name} was recovered.
error.outside_root: That path is outside the workspace.
error.symlink_not_followed: That is a link, and links are not followed.
error.already_exists: A file with that name already exists here.
error.unavailable: The workspace folder is not reachable.
error.lock_timeout: Another process is writing to this workspace.
error.unsupported: This storage does not support that.
error.io.disk_full: There is no space left on the disk. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.permission_denied: Permission denied writing that file. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.read_only_filesystem: That filesystem is read-only. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.io.not_found: The file is gone from the disk.
error.io.busy: The file is busy. Trying again shortly.
error.io.name_too_long: That name is too long for this filesystem.
error.io.other: The write failed. Your text is safe in a draft.
error.internal: Something went wrong inside notes. This is a bug.
view.hint: Ctrl+E cycles Source, Preview and Split
preview.blocked: {count} remote image(s) were not loaded. Blocking them keeps this note from telling anyone it was opened.
preview.blocked.allow: Allow remote images in this workspace
preview.failed: The preview could not be rendered. The note itself is untouched.
conflict.compare.title: {name} — yours and the file on disk
conflict.compare.removed: The file is no longer on disk.
conflict.compare.kept: Whichever you choose, the other version is kept — the app writes it aside before it does anything.
conflict.compare.coarse: These versions are too large to line up line by line, so the part that differs is shown as one block. Nothing is hidden.
tree.actions.hint: {path} — right-click for rename, duplicate, move and delete
tree.move.prompt: Folder to move it into, relative to the workspace root (empty for the root)
tree.delete.trashed: {name} was moved to the trash, so it can be put back.
tree.delete.permanent: {name} was deleted permanently — this filesystem has no trash.
watch.degraded: Changes made by other programs are picked up every few seconds rather than instantly: {reason}
dialog.name: Name
